title: Umklapp
tonal_field: D/A destinations and the suspension F remain. Audible gate-relative excursions and shared vibration make moving pitch part of the character.

sections.name: Induction
sections.intent: The centered pulse and offbeat engine establish one physical clock.

sections.name: Closed circuit
sections.intent: The low clock forms beneath a fixed, distant outline of the melodic pair.

sections.name: Signal transfer
sections.intent: The engine carries the accepted kick withdrawal. Signal elasticity develops through the repeating cell.

sections.name: Coupling
sections.intent: The first interlocked exchange opens into a complete block of deeper, connected flex.

sections.name: Field reversal
sections.intent: Physical anchors withdraw. Long coordinated arches move against the fixed D/A/F field.

sections.name: Mutual induction
sections.intent: A compact low-clock return establishes weight before a second complete expansion.

sections.name: Negative space
sections.intent: The signal clears space; the kick withdrawal and returning drums prepare metal's takeover.

sections.name: Current
sections.intent: Metal owns opening, recovery and stable landing; the A signal anchors it before rejoining.

sections.name: Residual magnetism
sections.intent: Remaining melodic destinations hold while the engine, field and veil complete their accepted withdrawal.

parts.name: Elastic kick
parts.role: A centered A1 tail and an unambiguous four-beat clock.

parts.name: Low engine
parts.role: The D1 clock develops through stroke length, throat/body balance and rare A1 turns.

parts.name: Bending signal
parts.role: The repeating call/recovery bends develop by section; each cell's closing D/A and the metal-takeover anchor remain firm.

parts.name: Metal lattice
parts.role: Replies share the signal's motion field; the final takeover inherits the full cell, including its stable landing.

parts.name: Resonant drums
parts.role: One interlocking membrane/rim phrase in the same sixteenth-note pocket.

parts.name: Metallic grain
parts.role: Offbeat articulation and sparse quiet subdivisions clarify the low engine.

parts.name: Pressure gestures
parts.role: Filtered noise and D-related resonance punctuate selected transitions.

parts.name: Residual field
parts.role: D/A space with one F color in the long suspension; a continuous phrase bridge.

parts.name: Relay murmurs
parts.role: A lower, soft reed-pluck answers the two-bar cell in selected eight-bar phrases.

parts.name: Phase veil
parts.role: Slow D/A voicings form a distant harmonic memory, breathing around the foreground.

authorship: Phrase-led foreground and return refinement of Study 07. Its complete musical performance and engineering character are preserved.
listening_state: Study 07 has positive feedback on quality. Study 08 awaits listening review; Study 04 remains the selected baseline.
